decisions.reason: The location-based gas tariff comparison sits close to the core tariff database, has its own page and costs little to maintain, so keeping the option open is still worthwhile.
The regional electricity tariff calculator is a cheap extension of the shared market-data base, and nothing so far shows that its value will not materialize.

This multi-model line is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with Product C, so consolidation is a real risk, but its upkeep on shared data is low and the uncertainty has not yet resolved against it.
The site-specific comparison line partly overlaps with Product B and has low visibility, but it rides on the same databases at little cost, so the option stays open for another period.
